items.title: File Widerspruch against BAföG decision
items.quote: Wenn Sie diese Entscheidung überprüfen lassen möchten, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe Widerspruch beim Studierendenwerk Mustertor, Mensaweg 2, 35392 Mustertor, ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Monday 2025-05-05 by a public-law authority governed by the VwVfG (not a Finanzamt/Familienkasse, so the delivery day does not move even on a weekend/holiday). 4-day deemed-delivery rule (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025): day1=06 May, day2=07 May, day3=08 May, day4=09 May (Friday) -> deemed delivered Fri 2025-05-09. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analog / general administrative law, counted per §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB): period starts the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month with the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 2025-06-09. 2025-06-09 is Whit Monday (Pfingstmontag), a nationwide public holiday, so per § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, Tuesday 2025-06-10.

items.title: Report changes in income, housing or studies immediately
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Änderungen bei Ihrem Einkommen, Ihrer Wohnung oder Ihrem Studium bitte sofort mit.
items.computation: The letter requires immediate ('sofort') notification of any relevant changes but gives no fixed calendar date or counting period, so no exact due date can be derived; this is an ongoing obligation for the whole funding period (04/2025–03/2026).
